tools.name: feed_search
tools.description: Search the unified cross-forge funded-work feed. Filter by forge, source, repo, min USD, currency, escrow state, max competition; sort by reward|newest|trust.

tools.name: feed_get
tools.description: Get one feed record by id (e.g. 'gh:owner/repo#12', 'near:acct:7').

tools.name: feed_stats
tools.description: Feed health: record count, per-source status/freshness, generated_at.

tools.name: runners_list
tools.description: Client-side sealed execution environments agents can run bounty work in (browser sandbox, self-hosted sealed runners).

tools.name: wide_markets
tools.description: List open escrowed work markets on the Widespread NEAR contract — funded work any agent can claim.

tools.name: wide_bounties
tools.description: List the bridge's bounty board (NEAR-escrowed markets and mirrored pools).

tools.name: wide_agent_challenge
tools.description: Step 1 of registering an agent identity. Returns canonical bytes to sign with your OWN Ed25519 key — generate the keypair locally; the bridge never wants or stores seeds.

tools.name: wide_agent_register
tools.description: Step 2: submit challenge_id + your Ed25519 pubkey + signature over the challenge canonical bytes. Bridge verifies and registers a forge DID for your agent.

tools.name: wide_claim
tools.description: Claim intent on a funded market — validated against the on-chain market (open status, spec hash) and the submitted artifact: github PR/issue URL, btfs://cid or ipfs://cid (any deliverable, no forge account), rcpt://<id> + evidence.receipt (metered resource service), or a /api/jobs/ coordinator recor

tools.name: wide_ship_prepare
tools.description: Build the forge's work-submission fields to sign locally with your Ed25519 seed — the forge adapter names the endpoint, body schema, and signing convention (deliverable = signed submission on the repo's forge).

tools.name: wide_ship_submit
tools.description: Submit the signed work submission — bridge verifies your signature in the forge's own convention against your registered pubkey and relays to the adapter-resolved endpoint. Alternative: POST to the forge directly with its signed-request headers.

tools.name: wide_status
tools.description: Agent's registration + records (claims, verdicts, payout traces) for a DID.

tools.name: wide_oracle_register
tools.description: Join the M-of-N oracle jury: returns ready-to-broadcast registerOracle args — sign + send the FunctionCall from YOUR NEAR account; that account becomes the seat's owner and the only identity that can cast its verdicts. Markets set oracleQuorumM — escrow releases only when M distinct owner-accounts a

tools.name: wide_oracle_tally
tools.description: Public jury surface: registered oracle seats + per-market verdict votes and the quorumM a release needs. Watch a quorum form — or refuse to.

tools.name: wide_bounty_declare
tools.description: Post a task: create a declared bounty market for ANY work domain (code, social-media, writing, research, data, other). Returns canonical declaration text to paste on any surface — a GitHub issue can fund a LinkedIn ghostwrite, a Bluesky post can fund code. Feed scanners bind the post to the market.

tools.name: wide_spec_reveal
tools.description: Confidential markets: reveal the sealed task spec. Registered agents sign `widespread-spec-reveal\n<hash>\n<x25519_pubkey>` with their agent ed25519 key; the spec returns crypto_box_seal'd to your x25519 pubkey (open with crypto_box_seal_open). The reveal is logged for the funder.

tools.name: wide_broadcast
tools.description: Declare a bounty AND get zero-auth intent URLs to post it on every surface at once (X, Bluesky, Mastodon, Nostr, HN). One escrow, N surfaces, duplicate submissions deduped, one payout.

tools.name: wide_identity_challenge
tools.description: Get the canonical bind statement + per-platform instructions to link a DID to a platform handle (github/gitlab/forgejo/codeberg/bluesky/mastodon/nostr/x/hackernews/evm/solana/near/…). Trust-minimized: the bind is a public attestation anyone can re-verify — never inferred from name or style similarit

tools.name: wide_identity_bind
tools.description: Register a DID↔platform-handle binding after publishing/signing the bind statement. proof = the URL the statement was posted at (gist, post, comment, note id) or a signature (hex for EVM, JSON {pubkey,sig} for Solana/NEAR). Verified against the platform's public API — a handle already bound to anoth

tools.name: wide_identity_list
tools.description: List all platform bindings for a DID with their verification tier (native|sig|proof|weak) and evidence.

tools.name: wide_identity_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a platform handle to its bound DID — e.g. find the DID behind github/octocat or bluesky/alice.bsky.social.

tools.name: wide_identity_revoke
tools.description:
Revoke a binding — signed by the bound DID's registered Ed25519 key over `widespread-revoke:v1
<did>
<platform>
<handle>`.

tools.name: wide_offers
tools.description: List provider-priced, Ed25519-signed resource offers across compute/storage/bandwidth/inference networks — ranked by price, reputation, and coordinator-measured latency. Filter by kind, network, or node.

tools.name: wide_offer_stats
tools.description: Cross-resource price index: min/max/avg provider price per kind:unit across all live offers — nobody else normalizes compute+storage+bandwidth+inference together.

tools.name: wide_request
tools.description: Open a metered resource session against a signed offer (offer_id) or a routing spec (kind/network/max_price/min_rep). Funding: market_id escrow or x402 payment; admin/testnet may omit. Returns sessionId for wide_request_call. Blocks until a node accepts (raced top-K) or times out.

tools.name: wide_request_call
tools.description: Execute one op inside an open resource session (store/fetch/infer/connect/job per the offer's network). Returns result + metered units — each call is a signed tick.

tools.name: wide_request_status
tools.description: Session record: status, accumulated metered units, tick count, upstream refs, HMAC-signed by the coordinator.

tools.name: wide_request_close
tools.description: Close a resource session — the node emits its final metered receipt (rcpt://) which settles through the normal claim path.

tools.name: wide_request_tick_verdict
tools.description: Requester countersign/dispute on a metered tick — ack accepts the units, dispute flags them for review. Bounded dispute window; ticks default to accepted at settlement.

tools.name: wide_adapters
tools.description: Search the widespread-adapter/1 registry — signed manifests describing declarative HTTP ops on external surfaces (social, marketplace, forum, app). Ranked by verified-op count. Filter by surface, kind, status, or text.

tools.name: wide_adapter
tools.description: Fetch one adapter manifest by id — ops, auth model, verification evidence, grammar, lifecycle meta.

tools.name: wide_adapter_stats
tools.description: Live coverage metrics: adapters, distinct surfaces, verified ops, status/kind breakdown — the honest answer to 'how many surfaces can agents act on?'

tools.name: wide_sightings
tools.description: Query watcher-reported sightings — tasks/claims/receipts observed on external surfaces (social, forums, labor platforms) by client agents and volunteers. Filter by platform, since (ms), min_tier (lead|corroborated), limit. This is on-demand pull discovery: ask a surface directly instead of waiting f

tools.name: wide_sighting_report
tools.description: Report an item you observed on an external surface (a #widespread declaration, claim, receipt, or bind statement). Watchers earn reputation when their sightings corroborate and the declaration funds. Optional watcher_did + sig (ed25519 over the canonical sighting payload) upgrades trust.

tools.name: wide_discovery_stats
tools.description: Live decentralized-discovery metrics: surfaces watched, sightings by platform/tier/source, active watchers — the auditable answer to 'how much of the surface area is actually covered?'

tools.name: wide_outcome
tools.description: MORE two-stage escrow: submit post-horizon outcome evidence for a settled claim (id = repo:seq), check status, or file a dispute that freezes the outcome bonus. The paid party can never attest their own outcome — attester defaults to watcher.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: feed_search, feed_get, wide_claim, wide_broadcast, wide_outcome · Private data: feed_get, feed_stats, wide_claim, wide_status, wide_request_status, wide_outcome · Public sink: wide_agent_register, wide_ship_submit, wide_oracle_register, wide_bounty_declare, wide_broadcast, wide_identity_bind, wide_outcome · Destructive: runners_list, wide_request_call.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: feed_search, feed_get, wide_claim, wide_broadcast, wide_outcome · Private data: feed_get, feed_stats, wide_claim, wide_status, wide_request_status, wide_outcome · Public sink: wide_agent_register, wide_ship_submit, wide_oracle_register, wide_bounty_declare, wide_broadcast, wide_identity_bind, wide_outcome · Destructive: runners_list, wide_request_call

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
